div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center;

span.p: 执行异常或证据不足，需要调整？

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center;

span.p: 存在范围内可执行调整且仍有预算？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 记录 AI 或人工建议；校验变更并保存新计划版本

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 根据原因记录执行异常、中止或未能验证

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 按成功判据判断验证成立或未能验证；必要时人工复核

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 关联漏洞、执行尝试、计划版本、载荷版本及证据

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 回填漏洞列表与拓扑；记录新发现及待补检查项

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center;

span.p: 还有选定漏洞需要验证？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 对照已知漏洞基准；未知分母不计算发现率

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 生成统计图表、结论及报告；列出未检查、失败和待复核项

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 归档必要证据与配置版本，执行计划内清理及环境恢复

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center;

span.p: 环境恢复并通过基线核对？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 标记恢复失败、环境不可复用；保留证据并处理问题

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center;

span.p: 需要复测或重复演示？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 新建关联运行，保留旧结果；重新确认范围与条件

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 归档任务；分别记录测试完成度与环境可复用状态

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 取消：停止派发并中止可中止调用，记录未停止项和已有结果

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 270px; text-align: center; width: 270px;

span.p: 确认调用已结束或隔离运行影响；标记未执行检查与未验证漏洞
